Implementation Plan ## Implementation plan: issue #8809, auto-approve test-only UNVERIFIED heal plans and lock implement to those paths Planning ref: `main` at `d92c2c47da19d6c8a57acec397fdb0d0ef0b9a7e`. The integration branch mismatch line reads `unknown`, not `true`, so this run is not blocked. Refs #8352 and #8808. #8808 has no code overlap with this change. ## Automation / wiring (§20.E) - **Scripts:** no new script. This extends `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py` (three new CLI modes), `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`, `scripts/implement_heal_preflight.sh` and `scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh` (a hook of a few lines, see Conflicts). - **Entry points:** - The "Auto-approve clear plan" step of `.github/workflows/plan.yml`, triggered by an `/answer` comment. - Poller stall recovery through `_plan_auto_approval_gate` in `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`, on its schedule. - The existing "Heal route preflight" step (around line 2290) and the isolated heal editor call (around line 3682) of `.github/workflows/implement.yml`. That file does not change: the preflight reads `ISSUE_COMMENTS_FILE`, which is already exported to `GITHUB_ENV` (around line 316) and filled before the preflight (around line 2265). The editor hook reads a variable the preflight writes to `GITHUB_ENV`. - **Long-running supervisor:** none. - **DB work:** none. - **`docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`:** no entry, because no script is added. - **Workflow size (§24):** `implement.yml` stays at 425,273 bytes (unchanged). `plan.yml` is 203,288 bytes plus about 3 KB. `orchestrate_poll.yml` is 134,481 bytes plus five env lines. All stay well under 480,000. ## Files likely to change - `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py` - `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` - `scripts/implement_heal_preflight.sh` - `scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh` - `.github/workflows/plan.yml` - `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` - `tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py` - `tests/test_plan_heal_counterfactual_gate.py` - `tests/test_implement_heal_preflight.py` - `tests/test_heal_isolated_editor.py` - `agents.d/8809-heal-test-only-auto-approve.md` (new) - `changelog.d/8809-heal-test-only-auto-approve.md` (new) ## Conflicts with the issue text - **Flag default line.** The issue says the flag default is "near line 2729". In fact `HEAL_COUNTERFACTUAL_GATE_ENABLED` is set at `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` line 2752, with its comment at lines 2749-2751. The new default goes right after line 2752. - **Section numbers.** The issue cites "§18.E" and "§27". In the unattended system instructions these are §20.E and §24. The content is the same. - **A file the issue does not list.** The issue puts all implement-side logic in `scripts/implement_heal_preflight.sh`. That script runs before the editor, so it cannot compare edited files with the base. The weakening counts therefore run in `scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh`, just before the existing host transfer (line 351). On refusal it returns the existing `exit 42`, and `implement.yml` (around line 3683) already turns that into `implement_heal_preflight.sh refuse out_of_heal_scope`. The preflight still owns the marker read and the narrowed write set. The new counting logic itself lives in `files_touched_scope_guard.py`. - **The poller cannot verify a heal scope today.** `workflow_failure_heal.py heal-scope verify` needs `last_edited_at` (`verify_heal_scope`, around line 3797). The batched query in `_fetch_candidate_issue_details_graphql` (fragment around line 20575, mapping around line 20630) does not ask for `lastEditedAt`, and the poller has no heal-scope verify call at all. This plan adds one scalar field to that existing batched query (see D3). - **`plan.yml` verifies the heal scope only in one case.** It does so only inside the automation-path block (lines 3083-3110), and only when the issue has the `ai:workflow-heal` label and `HEAL_PLAN_GRANT_BODY_EDIT_FIX_ENABLED` is on. The new check needs the verified scope earlier, so it runs the same two reads (`gh api user` plus the preflight's GraphQL query). The later block reuses that result instead of reading again (see D4). - **Confirmed as stated:** - Five `orchestrate_poll.yml` steps set `HEAL_COUNTERFACTUAL_GATE_ENABLED` (lines 935, 1345, 1563, 1659, 1687). - The CI partition counts tests at `ci.yml` around line 2337: `ast.FunctionDef` in `module.body` whose name starts with `test_`. - A heal scope always contains `tests/**` and `changelog.d/*.md` (`workflow_failure_heal.py` around line 3735). ## Functions or modules to implement ### 1. `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py`: three new modes These reuse `run_heal_plan_scope_gate`, `extract_plan_file_paths`, `_plan_grant_path`, `path_in_scope`, `normalize_allowlist` and `_read_allowlist`. **`run_heal_test_only_check(plan_file, heal_scope_file, flag_value, issue_number, plan_comment_id) -> (dict, int)`, CLI `--heal-test-only-check`** Arguments: `--plan-file`, `--heal-scope-file`, `--flag-enabled`, `--issue-number`, and a new `--plan-comment-id`. Flag handling: - `false` holds with `gate_disabled`. - Empty or `true` means on. - Any other value means on, and the output carries `flag_invalid: true`. It holds, with the named reason, in each of these cases: - The issue number does not match `^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$`, or the plan comment id does not match `^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$`: `plan_comment_unknown`. - `run_heal_plan_scope_gate(plan_file, heal_scope_file, "false", issue_number)` returns anything other than `heal_scope_verified`. The reasons map as follows: - Any protected path: `path_not_test_only`. - `heal_scope_check_unavailable`: kept as is. - `heal_scope_plan_paths_missing` or `heal_scope_plan_no_changes`: `plan_paths_missing`. - `heal_scope_plan_out_of_scope`: `path_not_exact` when any denied token is a glob or ends in `/`, otherwise `path_out_of_heal_scope`. - `plan_gate_error`: kept as is. - `extract_plan_file_paths` returns an empty list: `plan_paths_missing`. - Any path matches neither `^tests/[^\s]+$` (already exact through `_plan_grant_path`) nor `^changelog\.d/[^/]+\.md$`: `path_not_test_only`. This also covers the issue's own `agents.d` fragment, which the scope gate adds to the scope but which is not test-only. - There are more than 50 paths, or the marker would exceed 4,000 characters: `too_many_paths`. When every check passes, it approves with reason `test_only_paths`. The JSON is `{decision, reason, paths, marker, flag_invalid}`. `marker` is exactly ``. The guard composes it so both callers emit identical text. Exit codes follow `run_heal_plan_scope_gate`: `EXIT_IN_SCOPE` on approve, `EXIT_AUTOMATION_UNGRANTED` on hold. **`run_heal_test_only_lock_scope(comments_file, issue_number, pipeline_login, heal_scope_file, lock_out) -> (dict, int)`, CLI `--heal-test-only-lock-scope`** Arguments: `--comments-file`, `--issue-number`, `--pipeline-login`, `--heal-scope-file`, `--lock-out`. 1. Find the latest plan: the newest comment (by `created_at`) whose `user.login` equals the pipeline login and which has a line exactly `` after trimming. This is the same rule as the poller's jq at line 18534. 2. Read markers with `re.fullmatch`-style token parsing of ``. Only trusted comments count: pipeline login, `[bot]` suffix, or `author_association` in OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR. Take the newest trusted marker whose `issue` and `plan_comment` match. 3. If no plan or no matching marker exists, return `{status: "none"}`. 4. Otherwise each comma-split path must pass three checks: - `_plan_grant_path(p) == p`; - the test-only pattern; - `path_in_scope(p, scope, allow_lockfiles=False)`. If any path fails, or the list is empty, return `{status: "invalid", reason: }`. 5. If all paths pass, write them one per line to `lock_out` and return `{status: "locked", plan_comment, count}`. 6. Any exception returns `invalid` with `lock_scope_error`. **`run_heal_test_only_weakening_check(lock_file, base_dir, edited_dir) -> (dict, int)`, CLI `--heal-test-only-weakening-check`** Arguments: `--lock-file`, `--base-dir`, `--edited-dir`. Each lock path is validated again. For each path P, `base` is `base_dir/P` and `edited` is `edited_dir/P`. It refuses in these cases: - either side is a symlink, is not a regular file, or is larger than 2 MiB: `unreadable`; - `base` exists and `edited` is missing: `file_deleted`. For `.py` files under `tests/` it parses both sides with `ast`. A side that is missing counts as zero. A syntax error on either side refuses with `parse_error`. It then compares: - **`test_functions`:** top-level `ast.FunctionDef` or `ast.AsyncFunctionDef` named `test_*`, only for basenames `test_*.py`. Also, as a second counter, `test_*` methods of top-level `Test*` classes. Neither counter may drop. - **`asserts`:** `ast.Assert` nodes plus calls whose func is `Attribute(value=Name("self"), attr startswith "assert")`. The total may not drop. - **`skips`:** the number of: - attribute chains ending in `pytest.skip`, `pytest.mark.skip`, `pytest.mark.skipif`, `pytest.xfail`, `pytest.mark.xfail` or `pytest.importorskip`; - `unittest.skip*` or a bare `skip*` imported from unittest; - `self.skipTest`; - `unittest.SkipTest`; - assignments to `__test__`, `collect_ignore` or `collect_ignore_glob`; - definitions of `pytest_collection_modifyitems` or `pytest_ignore_collect`. The edited count may not exceed the base count (see D6). It returns 0 when nothing is refused. Otherwise it returns `EXIT_AUTOMATION_UNGRANTED` and writes `reason= path=

` to stderr. P is limited to the path alphabet and 300 characters. Any exception refuses. ### 2. `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` - **Flag default.** After line 2752: `HEAL_TEST_ONLY_AUTO_APPROVE_ENABLED="${HE
